# `hit-stop` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "hit-stop" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/hit-stop/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique table id; the game reads "hit-stop". |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `ticks` | object | required | Freeze length per hit tier, sim ticks: light, heavy, charged, parry and critical (a riposte). Overlapping freezes take the longest, never the sum. |
| `ticks.light` | integer 0–30 | required | A light attack (the default tier of a hitting move). |
| `ticks.heavy` | integer 0–30 | required | A heavy attack. |
| `ticks.charged` | integer 0–30 | required | A charged heavy. |
| `ticks.parry` | integer 0–30 | required | A parry deflecting an attack (both fighters). |
| `ticks.critical` | integer 0–30 | required | A riposte or other critical hit. |
